resources.string: Real-time on-device detection of AI-cloned voice scam calls
Protection idle. Choose a mode and tap Start.
Caution: the voice score is raised
WARNING: synthetic or cloned voice suspected!
Windows scored: %1$d | Last: %2$d ms | Average: %3$d ms (%4$s)
The voice model is not loaded. Only scam keyword spotting works.
No scam keywords detected in this session.
A keyword is only a hint and never proves fraud. It adds to an alert only together with the voice score.
Strong keyword signal. Do not share codes, PINs or card details.
Put the call on speakerphone and keep the phone near the speaker. The microphone listens to the caller. Android does not let apps read call audio directly, so this mode works on a best-effort basis.
Pick a call recording that you made with the consent of everyone on the call. This is the most reliable way to check a call.
Practice call inside the app. Play or speak audio near the microphone, or type words in the box below to test the scam keyword check.
Type what a caller might say. Needs no microphone. During a running test call the text is added to that session.
Example: please tell me the OTP, it is urgent
All audio is processed on this phone and is never uploaded. Only scores, alerts and matched keywords are saved. No audio is stored.
The microphone permission is required for VoiceGuard.
Text added to the running test call.
Please stop the running session first.
Allow VoiceGuard to display over other apps, then come back.
Listening. Waiting for the first window of audio.
Voice model not loaded. Keyword spotting only.
Possible AI-cloned voice on this call
This is a test of the warning banner.
No sessions yet. Start a live protection session or analyze a recorded call.
Sessions: %1$d | Sessions with a warning: %2$d | Warnings: %3$d | Marked as false alarm: %4$d (%5$d%% of warnings)
All saved sessions, scores, warnings and keyword hits will be deleted from this phone.

A warning is raised when the smoothed AI-voice score stays at or above this value. Lower values warn earlier but cause more false alarms.
Different phones treat these sources differently during a call. Try each one on your test phones (capture study). If a source is not available, the default microphone is used.
Shown in every warning. Do not type the secret code word itself here, only a reminder to ask for it.
Draws the warning on top of the dialer. Needs the permission to display over other apps.
The voice model is not loaded, so there is nothing to measure.

Default keywords come from the proposal (English and Urdu in Roman script). You can add your own words. Weight 1 is a weak hint, 3 is a strong hint.
